arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the result

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: model_type
arg.description: yolox for the YOLOX models (onnx), or detection_model for the models of cv::dnn::DetectionModel, e.g. YOLO (darknet), SSD (caffe, tensorflow), with config, input_width, input_height, scale and swap_rb

arg.name: model
arg.description: Path or URL of the model (e.g. .onnx, .weights), empty for YOLOX-S trained on COCO of opencv_zoo

arg.name: config
arg.description: Path or URL of the network configuration (e.g. .cfg) of the model, or empty

arg.name: classes
arg.description: Path or URL of the class names, one name per line, or empty for the classes of COCO for yolox

arg.name: backend
arg.description: Backend of cv::dnn: auto, cpu, opencl, opencl_fp16, cuda or cuda_fp16. auto uses CUDA when OpenCV is built with CUDA and a CUDA device is found, and the CPU otherwise.

arg.name: input_width
arg.description: Width of the network input, a multiple of 32 for yolox

arg.name: input_height
arg.description: Height of the network input, a multiple of 32 for yolox

arg.name: scale
arg.description: Multiplier of the pixel values for the network input, for detection_model

arg.name: swap_rb
arg.description: Swap the red and blue channels, true for the models trained in RGB, for detection_model

arg.name: confidence_threshold
arg.description: Threshold of the confidence to detect the objects

arg.name: nms_threshold
arg.description: Threshold of the overlap of the objects to suppress, by non maximum suppression
